title: SBVUL: Statement-Based Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.06135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many recent approaches for vulnerability detection use large language models (LLMs) to classify functions as vulnerable or benign, leaving developers to locate the exploitable statements. Furthermore, while these approaches have shown performance improvements, they still fall short in distinguishing vulnerable from patched real-world functions. This paper presents SBVul, an agentic approach that detects exploitable statements in C/C++ functions. In Phase~1, an LLM agent explores the function and its repository and identifies candidate statements. In Phase~2, a second agent analyzes the control and data flow of each candidate and confirms it, rules it out, or marks it uncertain. We created a manually verified ground truth of exploitable statements for 200 pairs of the PrimeVul Paired test set and ran SBVul with the open-weight models Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5. Phase~1 identifies ground-truth

translated_abstract: 许多近期的漏洞检测方法使用大语言模型（LLM）将函数分类为易受攻击或良性，而将定位可利用语句的工作留给开发者来完成。此外，尽管这些方法在性能上有所提升，它们在区分真实世界中易受攻击的函数与已修复函数方面仍然存在不足。本文提出了SBVul，一种用于检测C/C++函数中可利用语句的智能体化方法。在第一阶段，一个LLM智能体探索该函数及其所在的代码仓库，并识别出候选语句。在第二阶段，第二个智能体分析每个候选语句的控制流和数据流，并对其进行确认、排除或标记为不确定。我们为PrimeVul Paired测试集中的200对函数创建了经人工验证的可利用语句真值标注，并使用开放权重模型Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4.1 Flash以及Anthropic的Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5运行了SBVul。第一阶段识别出真值……
tldr: SBVul提出了一种两阶段智能体方法，通过LLM智能体探索函数与代码仓库来识别候选语句，并结合控制流和数据流分析，直接定位C/C++函数中可利用的漏洞语句，弥补了函数级漏洞检测无法精确定位漏洞位置的不足。
en_tdlr: SBVul presents a two-stage agentic approach that uses LLM agents to explore functions and their repositories to identify candidate statements, then analyzes control and data flows to directly locate exploitable vulnerability statements in C/C++ functions, addressing the limitation of function-level vulnerability detection in pinpointing exact vulnerability locations.
